description: Solve the open model in the Convexity cloud (paid per hour of machine time; needs a signed-in account with cloud solve enabled). Quote cloud_solve_machines first; pass wait: true to block until it finishes, then cloud_solve_fetch_result brings the solved model back beside the original.

confirm_cost.description: Required true for machine sizes above s: confirms the user has seen the hourly price and agreed.

machine_size.description: Cloud machine size from cloud_solve_machines. Default xs.

max_run_duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock cap for the whole job; the job is killed past it. Omit for the service default (1 hour).

max_workers.description: Scenarios solved in parallel on the machine (bounded by its capacity). Omit for the size default.

scenario_ids.description: Scenario ids to solve (null = base case). Omit to solve the active scenario.

solver_name.description: Solver engine. 'highs' is free and always available; 'mosek' needs the entitlement on the account.

timeout_seconds.description: With wait: give up waiting after this long (default 900).

wait.description: Block until the cloud job is terminal (progress is reported), then return its status. Default false: return once submitted.

name: cloud_solve_submit
